description: This file defines the PHP client class for interacting with the AWS CodeStar Connections service, including method signatures for various operations such as creating, deleting, retrieving, and listing connections and repositories.

classes.name: CodeStarconnectionsClient
classes.description: A PHP client class for AWS CodeStar connections service, extending the generic AwsClient to provide specific method signatures for interacting with the service API.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates a new AWS CodeStar connection.

methods.name: createHost
methods.description: Creates a new host for CodeStar connections.

methods.name: createRepositoryLink
methods.description: Creates a link between a repository and a CodeStar connection.

methods.name: deleteHost
methods.description: Deletes a host registered with CodeStar connections.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific connection.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specified host.

methods.name: getRepositoryLink
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific repository link.

methods.name: getRepositorySyncStatus
methods.description: Gets sync status of a repository.

methods.name: getResourceSyncStatus
methods.description: Gets the sync status of a resource.

methods.name: getSyncBlockerSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of sync blockers.
